stories.headline: Pearsall's Wagon Throws a Wheel in San Francisco, and Deebo Rides Back In
stories.read: John Lynch stepped to the porch Saturday and said it plain: Ricky Pearsall needs knee surgery and he's done for 2026 before the first shot was fired. That's a hard trail for a young fella who's had nothing but hard trail, and it leaves a pile of unclaimed throws sitting out in the open in Santa Clara. The Niners already saw it coming and brought Deebo Samuel back home on a one-year deal, so he's your cheapest way to stake that ground. Mike Evans is the safe horse, but Deebo and the slot man are where the real value's buried. Anybody still holding a Pearsall pick in a summer draft is holding fool's gold now, pardner. Cross him off the board.

stories.headline: Kyler's Got the Reins in Minnesota, and That Changes What Jefferson Is Worth
stories.read: The Vikings keep swearing it's a fair fight, but the snap ledger tells another story: Murray's been taking the lion's share of the first-team work while J.J. McCarthy waits his turn. Doc's watched him hit Justin Jefferson on deep crossers with a touch the young fella hasn't found yet. Here's what it means for your outfit: Jefferson limped in as the twenty-first-best receiver last season and the saloon still hasn't fully forgiven him for it. A real trigger man under center in Kevin O'Connell's system fixes that in a hurry. If Jefferson's slid a hair on your board, that's a gold vein nobody's dug yet. Go stake it.

stories.headline: Jadarian Price Is Runnin' Wild in Seattle While the Fellas Ahead of Him Are Laid Up
stories.read: The Seahawks took Price thirty-second overall in April, and every dispatch out of camp says the rookie is the loudest man on that field, catching deep balls out of the backfield like a wideout who wandered into the wrong meeting. Meanwhile Zach Charbonnet's hobbled and Kenny McIntosh is nursing his own troubles, which means the pecking order at that ranch is wide open. Doc's angle is simple, pardner: a first-round back with pass-catching chops and nobody healthy in front of him is exactly the shape of a bell-cow waiting to happen. He tweaked something Friday, so keep an eye on him. But if the herd's still grabbing him late because he's a rookie, that's cheap gold and you know it.
